description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing organizations within the Coocook application. It includes methods for creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and leaving organizations, with associated access control and data handling logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for organization management, handling CRUD operations and user interactions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new organization, validating input and checking name availability.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load organization by name and set it in the stash.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays organization details, including users and projects, with permission checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization metadata such as description and display name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the organization and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Allows a user to leave an organization.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization show page.
